sourceChecks.text: Obed-Edom had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sacar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,

sourceChecks.text: Sons were also born to Shemaiah his son, who ruled over the house of their father; for they were mighty men of valor.

sourceChecks.text: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad, whose relatives were valiant men, Elihu, and Semachiah.
